texts.zh: 尽管[From.GetName]的表面看似冰封，但该行星围绕[From.GetStarName]的运行轨道使其地表温度高达数百度，正常情况下，这会使[From.GetName]表面的冰瞬间升华。然而，该行星的超致密核所施加的极端重力使该行星表面的水保持固态，所以这个星球常年处于冰火两重天的状态。
texts.en: Despite the seemingly frozen surface of [From.GetName], the planet's orbital path around [From.GetStarName] leaves it blistering at several hundred degrees. Under normal circumstances this would sublimate the ice on [From.GetName]'s surface. However, extreme gravitational pressure exerted by the planet's ultra-dense core keeps the water in a solid state, resulting in a planet of fiery hot ice.

# 不一致的读数 / Inconsistent Readings

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（has_distar） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/95_anomaly_categories_distant_stars.txt:423-438; events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:3915 (distar.110)

## 如何开始 How it starts

需要《遥远繁星》。没有采矿站矿藏的冰冻星球可能生成（1级，权重1）。

Requires Distant Stars. Can spawn on a frozen planet without a mining-station deposit (level 1, weight 1).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

distar.110“冰封地狱”：星球被恒星炙烤到数百度，但超致密核心的引力压力让水保持固态，形成“炽热的冰”。星球获得物理学矿藏，记录标本 hot_ice。

distar.110 "White Hell": the planet is baked to hundreds of degrees, yet the pressure of its ultra-dense core keeps the water solid — fiery hot ice. The planet gains a physics deposit; specimen hot_ice.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一结果，无随机分支。

Single outcome; no random branch.

No empire-specific option differences.
